title: About Long Island Nepalese Society - NY
paragraphs: Long Island Nepali Society New York (LINSNY) was established in 2010 by members of the Nepali community in Long Island with a shared vision of bringing Nepali people together and building a strong, inclusive, and supportive community.

As a nonprofit organization, our mission is to unite Nepali individuals and families across Long Island, promote and preserve Nepali language, culture, traditions, and heritage, and foster mutual support and community engagement.

We strive to create a welcoming platform where Nepalis from all backgrounds, regions, ethnicities, and generations can connect, celebrate our shared heritage, exchange ideas, and support one another. Through cultural programs, community activities, educational initiatives, and service-oriented efforts, we work to strengthen our community while contributing positively to the broader New York community.

For more than a decade, LINSNY has served as a bridge connecting Nepalis in Long Island and beyond. We remain committed to building unity in diversity, preserving our identity, empowering our community, and creating opportunities for future generations.
